description.en:
Turns on the out-of-focus blur post-effect ("boke", the Japanese word for this kind of blur) and fades it in to a given strength over a number of frames.
The game uses it for its dialogue scenes: ev_main's StartStandEvent narrows the camera's depth of field and switches this blur on, so the background goes soft behind the characters who are talking. EndStandEvent undoes it with CMND_BOKE_DELETE.
Use CMND_BOKE_FADE to change the strength while the effect is on.
Target blur strength. The dialogue scenes use 0.9.
Length of the fade-in, in frames. The dialogue scenes use 7.

true once the effect has been started.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Blurring the background for a dialogue scene (real usage, from ev_main's StartStandEvent)
